proposed.text: A basement storage room with 7 occupants is used for purposes other than service. Per PD 1096 Rule XII, how many exits are required?

options.text: 1 exit, because occupant load is below 10, which is the threshold for requiring additional exits
2 exits, because basements used for other than service use require 2 exits regardless of occupant load
3 exits, because basements require the same exit count as floors above 2nd storey, which is a common misconception
1 exit, because storage rooms are exempt from exit requirements, although this exemption is often misunderstood

Restored the original verbatim. Original source rationale: Per Rule XII, Sec. 1207(2)(a), basements and cellars used for other than service use require at least 2 exits regardless of occupant load. A storage room used beyond pure service purposes triggers this requirement. The >10 occupant load rule is separate from the basement rule.
